notes.title: Sharpen Your Axe! Brutal Gamescom Trailer Unveils Tails of Iron 2 Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/f8e5e1a238bb830aa5e3f1d7c22a0e2dd9a837a5.png[/img]
[h3]Hear Ye, Ratkind![/h3]

A new saga is about to begin… We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter[/i] is officially launching in February 2025! Get ready to take up the mantle of Arlo, son of the Warden of the North, pick up a sharpened battle axe (or broadsword or spear… there are plenty of weapons of choice!) and defend your homeland after the devastating attack by the Dark Wings - an ancient evil from the frozen wastelands beyond.

In our brand new trailer, we’ve unveiled fresh gameplay footage showcasing Arlo’s brutal journey of survival and revenge. The Viking-esque aesthetic of this new story is emphasized by Fever Ray’s haunting 2008 track, ‘If I Had a Heart’ – we think it’s a fitting accompaniment to the harsh and unforgiving world Arlo must navigate through in the game.

[previewyoutube=Sg5FBayiuWc;full][/previewyoutube]
The new release date ensures we can provide the very best experience possible, and we absolutely cannot wait to reveal what’s in store for would-be vikings come early 2025. 

[h3]Your Feedback & Next steps[/h3]

We were truly humbled to see so many of you dive into the demo during June’s Steam Next Fest. Your enthusiasm and support means everything to us, and we’ve been listening closely to your feedback. Many of you enjoyed the new gameplay mechanics we introduced, but there was one point that needed a little attention – the weapon sharpening mechanic.

Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we’re making the following adjustments to the game at launch:

[list]
[*] Whetstones will now act more like weapon buffs; when used, they will increase the weapon's damage output for a limited time, similar to the poison mechanic in the original [i]Tails of Iron[/i].
[*] Weapons will no longer dull, resulting in bounce back and the inability to hit enemies. This has been entirely removed.
[*] Managing the ‘health’ of the whetstone is no longer a requirement.
[*] Whetstones are now purchasable at the shop and can also be found in the world and as an enemy drop.
[/list]
We believe these changes will make for a more fluid and enjoyable experience, and we’re incredibly grateful for your input, which has been essential in refining the game. With these improvements, we’re looking forward to bringing you an adventure truly worthy of the Viking sagas of old!

notes.title: OUT NOW - The Great ‘Key Remapping’ Update
notes.notes:
Attention, Royal Rodents!

You spoke, we listened. And today, a new decree (aka update) will roll out across the Kingdom. The version number is, let's say “overcomplicated”, so we’ll just call this the great ‘Key Remapping’ update of 2021 because let’s face it, that’s why we’re all here.

In a nutshell (mmm, [i]nut shells![/i]), this patch will deliver the following:
[list]
[*] Key Remapping for keyboard and mouse
[*] A toggle for NPC SFX
[*] Expanded controller support for PS5
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/d0f73aefd136e9fe3b83a8eb9789c457cb664270.png[/img]

[h2]Key Remapping[/h2]

When creating a game, you try your hardest to get everything perfect, and really drill into every detail, whether that’s the art, the animations, audio, music, SFX (squeak!) or one of the many other numerous components. But paws held high, it turns out we overlooked one important feature many of you hold dear. So, since release, and having read all of your comments (many of which blew us away with their kind words!), we’ve worked diligently to implement key remapping on keyboard and mouse to [i]Tails of Iron[/i]. So no more excuses when Dennis the Bold repeatedly kicks your *flute whistles*! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/1d3cc65abd86678b0c7fc737b4a81646a52d6150.png[/img]

[h2]Toggle for NPC SFX[/h2]

We heard you, again, and in response, have added a toggle in the settings to turn off all NPC sound effects. Flip the switch and you’ll no longer hear all the beautiful sounds of your rat brethren. Not even their heartfelt sobs, in the knowledge they’ve been forever silenced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40703556/6d444908a4e5a4548f7f1554063c2560463671a6.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded controller support[/h2]

You should experience far fewer issues when connecting a PS5 controller now.
[i]Nintendo Switch, PS4 and Xbox controllers were already supported from day one.[/i]

That wraps this patch up for the day. We hope this makes your journey through Rat Kingdom that little bit smoother. Let’s celebrate with a nice, cool bug juice! 

If you've not already jumped into Rat Kingdom, then there's no better time than now! Head to the store page, for your tail begins...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283410/Tails_of_Iron/
